title: Active Fill Border Color
description: Whenever something has an active filling then the border should also change to active color. e.g. currently navbar toggles, etc still show the default border color even when active
summary: Active interactive controls now pair primary fill with active border color. Added `border-active-base` utility and `interactiveActiveBorderClass`, composed into shared on/active/selected class tokens. Navbar, footer, and toolbar shell CSS now set `border-color: var(--active-base)` on pressed group items (overriding the normal-border `!important` rules). Slider thumb, engagement options, and dropdown selections use the shared active fill token.
